name: Cebu Open 2015
information: Early bird rate is Php 150.00 for 1 event only, Php 250.00 for any 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event, cut-off date is October 18, 2015.  Regular rate is Php 200.00 for 1 event only, Php 300.00 for any 3 events and Php 50.00 additional fee for each additional event. For information please visit the official Cebu Open 2015 facebook page.
